body:
> Correct, for publishing an experimental, the flow would be:
> 
>     1. `VERSION=4.X.X-typescript.X yarn build`
> 
>     2. `yarn build:types`
> 
>     3. ` npm publish --tag typescript`
> 
> 
> (or `typescript-experimental`)

Shouldn't it be something like

1. `yarn build`
2. `npm publish`
3. `VERSION=4.X.X-typescript.X yarn build:types`
4. `npm publish --tag typescript`
